fixtureBoundary: Isolated artificial unit positions/HP/AP/death and objective thresholds test rule edges only. Independent full campaign wins use normal commands and untouched published state.
tests: ten unique maps, three themes, three combined objectives and shared unit prototypes
four-neighbor BFS respects range, blockers, occupied squares and board limits
move preview is pure and commit spends exactly one AP along a legal path
occupied destinations, allied attacks and movement through friendly units are rejected
supercover line blocks high walls and diagonal wall corners
water and low cover leave sight open while intervening units block it
deterministic cover damage applies only beyond adjacent range with a minimum of one
attack previews exact target HP and stale repeated command cannot spend another AP
repair costs one AP, caps at maximum, is once per own turn and never revives
dead units vacate their square and cannot take any action
wait forfeits only remaining AP and cannot be repeated or used across sides
end-turn command is revision-guarded; enemy actions consume finite AP and terminate
enemy cannot read unsubmitted UI fields and deterministic replies match
enemy medic shares the same one-per-turn repair and AP rule
last enemy kill alone cannot win escort; living courier must also reach exit
courier death or no surviving combat unit takes priority over cleared enemies and exit
hold progress is counted after enemy reply, requires a survivor and breaks on leaving
completed hold count saturates while threats remain and the current turn stays restorable
last allowed round can complete objective; incomplete objective then fails uniquely
pause rejects every action and freezes both player and enemy phases
current player turn restores exact HP/AP/positions/revision without refills
mid-enemy save resumes remaining AP and produces identical final committed board
corrupt version, AP/HP/type/position/overlap/counters and impossible outcomes reject
ready save remains fresh and published maps remain immutable
